summary.name: Miro AI
summary.one_liner: Miro AI is an AI layer for Miro's collaborative whiteboard canvas that uses team content as context for AI agents (Sidekicks) and multi-step visual workflows (Flows).
use_cases: Turning brainstorm and workshop boards into OKRs or dashboards
Creating diagrams and decision records from engineering discussions
Building campaign concepts and content plans from a brief
Mapping customer journeys into service blueprints
Running retros and design sprints with AI assistance
Analyzing competitor moves on a shared canvas
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Miro AI as an AI platform built into Miro's collaborative canvas, where teams, AI agents, and their context work together. Sidekicks are AI agents that read existing board content (brainstorms, design sprints, retros) and generate frames, timelines, kanbans, and diagrams on the canvas. Flows are visual, multi-step AI workflows that teams can build, run, save as templates, and share across an organization. The page says Flows and Sidekicks can pull live data from tools such as Slack, Jira, and Granola. It also lists AI governance features: granular access controls, automatic sensitive content blocking, data residency across four regions, and ISO 42001 certification.
notable: Sidekicks: AI agents that build frames, timelines, kanbans and diagrams live on the canvas
Flows: shareable multi-step visual AI workflows built from canvas content
Connects to Slack, Jira, Granola and other tools for live context
ISO 42001 certification and data residency across four regions
caveats: Page is mostly marketing; pricing and plan details are not stated on this page
Some features are described for enterprise deployment, and the page does not specify which plans include them
Listing describes it as free, but the page itself does not confirm a free tier
